architecture_contract.warning: The 218 MB safetensors object includes long-context buffers in addition to the paper's 6.6M trainable parameters; exact state keys, shapes, buffers, and trainable count remain to be frozen after approved acquisition.

representation_and_task_contract.common_lane: Mean-pool final hidden states over the fixed 1536-bp variant-centered region for REF and ALT, repeat on reverse complements, realign coordinates, average orientations, and fit identical linear and two-layer heads to REF, ALT, ALT-minus-REF, and absolute-difference features.
representation_and_task_contract.native_zero_shot_lane: Compute ALT-minus-REF autoregressive sequence log-likelihood over matched affected suffixes, repeat on reverse complements, average orientations, and normalize by the fixed number of scored nucleotides.
representation_and_task_contract.causal_warning: A forward causal score only uses left context. Reverse-complement averaging is mandatory and must use matched scored bases; whole-sequence sums with unequal lengths are not comparable.
representation_and_task_contract.signed_effect_limit: Autoregressive likelihood is not a cell-type regulatory direction. Supervised signed-effect heads require nonsealed development outcomes.

runtime_contract.warning: The exact Hugging Face development-build dependency is unresolved, and million-base inference is not assumed to fit or be numerically stable on L40S. Context length is a campaign resource variable, not an automatic default.

source_evidence: The NeurIPS 2023 paper, pinned official code, exact Hugging Face revision, and public Basenji interval metadata were queried on 2026-08-22. No checkpoint bytes were downloaded or loaded.
